scenes.tts: If the race reads the cytoskeleton at a tip, can you rig it?
scenes.visual: Title card: Rig the Race. Five stage 2 neurites; one growth cone highlighted.
scenes.narration: If the race reads the cytoskeleton at a tip, can you rig it?

scenes.tts: Start with what the winner's tip looks like.
scenes.visual: Zoom into the growth cones of a stage 3 neuron.
scenes.narration: Start with what the winner's tip looks like.

scenes.tts: In 1999, Frank Bradke and Carlos Dotti looked at growth cones in cultured hippocampal neurons.
scenes.visual: On screen: Bradke and Dotti, 1999.
scenes.narration: In 1999, Frank Bradke and Carlos Dotti looked at growth cones in cultured hippocampal neurons.

scenes.tts: The future axon's growth cone had a looser, more dynamic actin network than its siblings.
scenes.visual: Side by side: a dense actin mat in a sibling's growth cone, a looser, moving net in the gold one.
scenes.narration: The future axon's growth cone had a looser, more dynamic actin network than its siblings.

scenes.tts: But is loose actin a cause of winning, or a consequence?
scenes.visual: Two arrows between loose actin and winning, one each way, with a question mark.
scenes.narration: But is loose actin a cause of winning, or a consequence?

scenes.tts: Test it. Cytochalasin D is a drug that interferes with actin assembly.
scenes.visual: Label: cytochalasin D interferes with actin assembly.
scenes.narration: Test it. Cytochalasin D is a drug that interferes with actin assembly.

scenes.tts: At stage two, before any neurite pulls ahead, apply a low dose to one growth cone only.
scenes.visual: A micropipette puffs the drug at one growth cone of an unpolarized neuron; its actin mesh loosens.
scenes.narration: At stage two, before any neurite pulls ahead, apply a low dose to one growth cone only.

scenes.tts: What happens to that neurite? And what if you bathe the whole cell in the drug?
scenes.visual: Two panels: local puff, whole-dish wash. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: What happens to that neurite? And what if you bathe the whole cell in the drug?

scenes.tts: The treated neurite was likely to become the axon.
scenes.visual: The puffed neurite turns gold and grows.
scenes.narration: The treated neurite was likely to become the axon.

scenes.tts: On screen is an idealized tally. By chance, one neurite in five would win. The drugged one wins far more often.
scenes.visual: Idealized data on screen: treated neurite becomes the axon in 26 of 40 neurons; random neurite in untreated neurons, 8 of 40.
scenes.narration: On screen is an idealized tally. By chance, one neurite in five would win. The drugged one wins far more often.

scenes.tts: And bathed in the drug, a neuron could grow several axons.
scenes.visual: Whole-dish wash: several neurites on one neuron turn gold.
scenes.narration: And bathed in the drug, a neuron could grow several axons.

scenes.tts: In 2008, Harald Witte, Dorothee Neukirchen and Frank Bradke did the same with microtubules.
scenes.visual: On screen: Witte, Neukirchen and Bradke, 2008.
scenes.narration: In 2008, Harald Witte, Dorothee Neukirchen and Frank Bradke did the same with microtubules.

scenes.tts: Taxol is a drug that stabilizes microtubules.
scenes.visual: Label: taxol stabilizes microtubules.
scenes.narration: Taxol is a drug that stabilizes microtubules.

scenes.tts: A flash of light released a taxol analogue in one neurite. That neurite became more likely to be the axon.
scenes.visual: A flash of light on one neurite; its microtubules steady; the neurite turns gold.
scenes.narration: A flash of light released a taxol analogue in one neurite. That neurite became more likely to be the axon.

scenes.tts: Low dose taxol given to the whole neuron led several neurites to grow as axons.
scenes.caption: Low-dose taxol given to the whole neuron led several neurites to grow as axons.
scenes.visual: Whole-neuron taxol: several gold neurites.
scenes.narration: Low-dose taxol given to the whole neuron led several neurites to grow as axons.

scenes.tts: Now block the positive loop everywhere, with P I three kinase blocked throughout.
scenes.caption: Now block the positive loop everywhere, with PI3-kinase blocked throughout.
scenes.visual: The loop diagram from the last chapter, with the PI3-kinase slot crossed out in every neurite.
scenes.narration: Now block the positive loop everywhere, with PI3-kinase blocked throughout.

scenes.tts: This is reported to leave no neurite becoming an axon. It does not free the others. It stops all of them.
scenes.visual: Five short neurites; no gold anywhere.
scenes.narration: This is reported to leave no neurite becoming an axon. It does not free the others. It stops all of them.

scenes.tts: Two results fit the race at once. A local boost rigs it. Blocking the loop everywhere leaves no winner.
scenes.visual: Two ticked cards: local boost, one winner; loop blocked, no winner.
scenes.narration: Two results fit the race at once. A local boost rigs it. Blocking the loop everywhere leaves no winner.

scenes.tts: The several axon result needs a second look.
scenes.caption: The several-axon result needs a second look.
scenes.visual: The several-gold-axon neuron returns, with a question mark.
scenes.narration: The several-axon result needs a second look.

scenes.tts: If every neurite's supply is tripled in this model, one still wins.
scenes.visual: Illustrative model bars, labelled: illustrative model, not a drug. Every bar's supply tripled; one bar still runs away, four shrink to the floor.
scenes.narration: If every neurite's supply is tripled in this model, one still wins.

scenes.tts: So a plain speed-up of this kind does not match the several axon result.
scenes.visual: On screen: a plain speed-up does not give several axons.
scenes.narration: So a plain speed-up of this kind does not match the several-axon result.
scenes.caption: So a plain speed-up of this kind does not match the several-axon result.

scenes.tts: One possible reading is a threshold. The model does not test it.
scenes.visual: A dashed horizontal line across all five neurites. Label: one possible reading, not tested by the model.
scenes.narration: One possible reading is a threshold. The model does not test it.

scenes.tts: On that reading, the drug pushes each neurite past whatever level of loose actin or stable microtubules marks an axon.
scenes.visual: Several neurites rise past the dashed line together and turn gold.
scenes.narration: On that reading, the drug pushes each neurite past whatever level of loose actin or stable microtubules marks an axon.

scenes.tts: Each one crosses that line without having to win the race.
scenes.visual: No runner breaks the tape; several cross the line side by side.
scenes.narration: Each one crosses that line without having to win the race.

scenes.tts: Either way, the race reads the cytoskeleton at the tip. Next, the microtubules become tracks.
scenes.visual: Closing card: the race reads the cytoskeleton. Next: Tracks That Point Two Ways.
scenes.narration: Either way, the race reads the cytoskeleton at the tip. Next, the microtubules become tracks.
